query: How do I replace batteries in a smoke detector?

goal.title: Replace the smoke detector battery
goal.description: Detach a wall-mounted smoke detector and exchange its rectangular battery. Reopen the compartment to adjust the replacement, test the detector, then twist it back onto its mounting plate.
goal.final_state: The detector is back on its wall plate with the battery door closed. A red indicator is visible during button presses; the silent video cannot establish alarm sound or electrical performance.

procedure.description: Approach the wall-mounted detector. Grip and twist it several times, briefly releasing and trying again, until its body begins to detach from the circular mounting plate.
Lower and turn the detector, open its battery door, pull the tray outward and work the blue rectangular battery free. Move the removed battery away from the detector.

Lower the old battery and retrieve another from packaging on the nearby stool. Turn the new battery toward the compartment, slide it inside, close the door and press the front test button while holding the detector.
Open the battery door again, remove the same replacement battery, rotate it in the right hand and make several alignment attempts. Seat it again and press the compartment shut.

Press the test button again; a red indicator illuminates. Change grip, raise the detector to its mounting plate and twist it into place. Check its attachment with both hands, press the mounted test button and withdraw the hands. No audible test result is available.

notes: All fine boundaries preserved. No soundtrack: button pressing and red light are visible, but successful audible alarm testing is not asserted. Replacement battery is distinguished from old one by the package retrieval; both use canonical battery as visually similar instances. Same battery is removed and reseated after first test. Fixed mounting plate is a target, never held. Hands holding detached detector support its body; button pressing alone on the mounted detector is not in_hand. Every dense page and native end frame reviewed; evidence uses PTS burn before fps.

coarse.instruction: Detach the smoke detector from its mounting plate
coarse.description: Approach the detector, repeatedly grip and twist its body, release and retry, then lower it away from the exposed mounting plate.
coarse.goal_contribution: Makes the battery compartment accessible without the detector being mounted on the wall.

coarse.instruction: Remove the existing smoke detector battery
coarse.description: Open the battery door, pull the tray outward, free the rectangular battery and move it away from the detector.
coarse.goal_contribution: Removes the existing power source so it can be replaced.
coarse.predictability_reason: Detached detector is ready for its old battery to be removed.

coarse.instruction: Install and check the replacement battery
coarse.description: Set the removed battery aside, retrieve a replacement, align and insert it, close the compartment, turn the detector and press its test button.
coarse.goal_contribution: Places a replacement power source in the detector and performs an initial visible button check.
coarse.predictability_reason: The empty battery compartment is ready for a replacement and check.

coarse.instruction: Reseat the replacement battery and test again
coarse.description: Reopen the door, remove and rotate the battery, realign and seat it, close the compartment and press the front button again.
coarse.goal_contribution: Corrects the initial installation attempt before returning the detector to its mount.
coarse.predictability_reason: A second reseating and test is plausible if the first check is uncertain.

coarse.instruction: Mount and check the smoke detector
coarse.description: Turn and raise the detector, align it with the wall plate, twist it into position, check its attachment, press its button and inspect it after releasing.
coarse.goal_contribution: Restores the detector to its installed position and checks the mounted unit.
coarse.predictability_reason: Once the battery is seated and tested, the detector can be mounted.
